title: Incorrect timestamp comparison leads to cooldown bypass
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description In `sdeusd.move`, unstake uses `clock::timestamp_ms(clock)` (milliseconds) to compare against `cooldown_end`, which is set using `clock_utils::timestamp_seconds(clock)` (seconds).
